text:
sana: Heads-up — model intake prioritization for next week. Need quick scores and bring-up checklists for two candidates: Llama3-40B-Cust and Atlas-70B-quant. Sync Wed 10:00?
jeff: +1 for Atlas-70b quant. My main blocker is missing p99 latency at 2k context. Can someone run microbench? :eyes:
maria: we should gate on 3 eval buckets: quality/regression, safety, perf. propose quick scoring rubric below.
aaron: I ran a quick batch earlier — rough numbers: Atlas-70b-quant (fp16->4bit) throughput ~420 tok/s on rtx-a5000, Llama3-40b-cust ~1100 tok/s (fp16) on same. Need consistent env though.
lina: can we include quantization effort estimate (days) in score? ops and infra need that for capacity planning.
sana: yes — do scoring as: 1) Quality (0-5), 2) Perf (0-5), 3) Quant effort (0-3), 4) Safety/regression risk (0-3), 5) Strategic alignment (0-4). max 20. Put short rationale.
maria: sample rubric snippet:
```
# scoring hint
Quality: run 5 core evals (summ, conv, code, reasoning, hf-datasets)
Perf: p50/p95/p99 at 512/2k ctx, tok/s and memory
Quant effort: 0=no,1=light(2-3d),2=moderate(1wk),3=heavy(>1wk)
Safety risk: 0=low,3=high (requires mitigations)
Strategic: product value + infra fit (0-4)
```
jeff: can we add a binary "fallback compatibility" flag — whether a smaller variant exists for graceful degradation?
sana: good call — add +1 if fallback exists. adjust max to 21.
aaron: creating intake ticket INF-4321 with initial notes and perf table. deploy-bot: created ticket INF-4321 for "Atlas/Llama intake" by aaron.
maria: i'll do a quick regression run vs current prod baseline (subset) Wed morning and post diffs.
lina: ops: if quantized model needs special kernel (ex: custom int4), tag it so we can schedule nodes.
sana: To keep this lightweight, please post final numeric score + single-sentence rationale in-thread by Tue EOD. We'll triage Wed 10 and assign owners. :thumbsup:
jeff: noted — I'll run perf at 2k ctx Tue afternoon and post.
maria: regression run scheduled Tue 2pm.
aaron: uploaded mini perf table to INF-4321 and linked quick run logs.
sana: perfect — thanks all. If anyone can't make Wed sync ping me and we'll async triage. :sparkles:
